Predicted local-to-global speaker mapping uses no references; scoring reuses the frozen whole-source Nemotron-to-reference identity mapping.
DER reuses unchanged Nemotron exclusive activity and cannot show improvement from changing ASR.
All raw lexical content, fillers, numbers and unknown words retained.
BF16 GGUF/f16 KV port is separately versioned; no claim of bitwise parity with native HF BF16 runtime.
